## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`, `project(DtkCore)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
```

The top-level script has no `install()` rule, so build artifacts stay in `build/`.

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 19 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `libdtkcommon-dev`
- `libicu-dev`
- `libuchardet-dev`
- `libdbus-1-dev`
